# graphiant_alert_rules (Data Source)

The fixed catalog of alert rules and their current enabled state. Rules are not created via the API (there is no create/update/delete for rules, only this list and a bulk enable/disable action which this provider doesn't yet expose).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_alert_rules" "all" {}

output "disabled_rules" {
  value = [for r in data.graphiant_alert_rules.all.rules : r.rule_name if !r.enabled]
}
```
